description: Repo-scale (php-library): enforce a member's maxActiveLoans cap from BOTH the borrow and transferLoan mutation paths
prompts: Members gain an optional `maxActiveLoans` field (a non-negative integer, or null meaning unlimited) - accept it as an optional third constructor/`create()` argument. Add `LoanService::transferLoan(int $loanId, int $newMemberId): Loan`, which moves an active loan to a different member (throw LibraryException if the loan isn't active, or the new member doesn't exist). The invariant: a member's active loan count must never exceed their maxActiveLoans. This must be validated from BOTH places that can newly assign an active loan to a member: (1) `borrow()`, and (2) `transferLoan()` - both must throw LibraryException if the target member is already at capacity.

<?php

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/LoanService.php';

final class ActiveLoanCapTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testBorrowRejectedWhenMemberAtCapacity(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $member = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com', 1);
        $b1 = $books->create('A', 'x', 1);
        $b2 = $books->create('B', 'x', 1);

        $service->borrow($b1->id, $member->id);
        $this->expectException(\App\LibraryException::class);
        $service->borrow($b2->id, $member->id);
    }

    public function testTransferRejectedWhenTargetMemberAtCapacity(): void
    {
        $books = new \App\BookRepository();
        $members = new \App\MemberRepository();
        $loans = new \App\LoanRepository();
        $service = new \App\LoanService($books, $members, $loans);

        $full = $members->create('Ada', 'a@example.com', 1);
        $other = $members->create('Bob', 'b@example.com');
        $b1 = $books->create('A', 'x', 1);
        $b2 = $books->create('B', 'x', 1);

        $service->borrow($b1->id, $full->id);
        $loan = $service->borrow($b2->id, $other->id);

        $this->expectException(\App\LibraryException::class);
        $service->transferLoan($loan->id, $full->id);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/Member.php';

class MemberRepository
{
    /** @var array<int, Member> */
    private array $members = [];
    private int $nextId = 1;

    public function create(string $name, string $email, ?int $maxActiveLoans = null): Member
    {
        $member = new Member($this->nextId, $name, $email, $maxActiveLoans);
        $this->members[$member->id] = $member;
        $this->nextId++;
        return $member;
    }

    public function find(int $id): ?Member
    {
        return $this->members[$id] ?? null;
    }

    /** @return Member[] */
    public function all(): array
    {
        $members = array_values($this->members);
        usort($members, fn(Member $a, Member $b) => $a->id <=> $b->id);
        return $members;
    }
}
reference_solution.src/LoanService.php:
<?php

namespace App;

require_once __DIR__ . '/BookRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/MemberRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LoanRepository.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/LibraryException.php';

class LoanService
{
    private BookRepository $books;
    private MemberRepository $members;
    private LoanRepository $loans;

    public function __construct(BookRepository $books, MemberRepository $members, LoanRepository $loans)
    {
        $this->books = $books;
        $this->members = $members;
        $this->loans = $loans;
    }

    private function activeLoanCapExceeded(int $memberId): bool
    {
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null || $member->maxActiveLoans === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $activeCount = count(array_filter(
            $this->loans->forMember($memberId),
            fn(Loan $l) => $l->status === 'active'
        ));
        return $activeCount >= $member->maxActiveLoans;
    }

    public function borrow(int $bookId, int $memberId): Loan
    {
        $book = $this->books->find($bookId);
        if ($book === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('book not found');
        }
        $member = $this->members->find($memberId);
        if ($member === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if ($book->availableCopies <= 0) {
            throw new LibraryException('no copies available');
        }
        if ($this->activeLoanCapExceeded($memberId)) {
            throw new LibraryException('member is at maxActiveLoans capacity');
        }

        $book->availableCopies--;
        return $this->loans->create($bookId, $memberId, 'active');
    }

    public function returnLoan(int $loanId): Loan
    {
        $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
        if ($loan === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
        }
        if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
            throw new LibraryException('loan already returned');
        }

        $loan->status = 'returned';
        $book = $this->books->find($loan->bookId);
        if ($book !== null) {
            $book->availableCopies++;
        }
        return $loan;
    }

    /**
     * Transfers an active loan to a different member (e.g. correcting a
     * mis-scanned card). Must respect the target member's
     * maxActiveLoans cap, same as borrow().
     */
    public function transferLoan(int $loanId, int $newMemberId): Loan
    {
        $loan = $this->loans->find($loanId);
        if ($loan === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('loan not found');
        }
        if ($loan->status !== 'active') {
            throw new LibraryException('only an active loan can be transferred');
        }
        $newMember = $this->members->find($newMemberId);
        if ($newMember === null) {
            throw new LibraryException('member not found');
        }
        if ($this->activeLoanCapExceeded($newMemberId)) {
            throw new LibraryException('member is at maxActiveLoans capacity');
        }

        $loan->memberId = $newMemberId;
        return $loan;
    }
}
